newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH PTT SAYS HAS 96.3 PCT OF TNT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH PTT SAYS HAS 96.3 PCT OF TNT.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Wednesday it was entitled to 96.3 percent of the ordinary shares and 96.3 percent of the convertible preference shares of Australia's TNT.
Dutch PTT (KPN) said on Tuesday it was entitled to 93.5 percent of the ordinary and 85.9 percent of convertible preference shares.
The company said its bid for the Australian company would close on December 12 at 1900 hours local time in Sydney.

It added that it would start a compulsory purchase procedure for all ordinary and convertible preference shares that had not yet been offered at that time and appealed to all TNT shareholders who had not yet accepted the bid, to do so immediately.
